findings.assessment: Printed opening explicitly 3/8. P031 repeats the two-sharp key without a new meter. SmartScore raw1 declares 4/4 but maps to P031 and does not establish a meter change.
P031 system begins with two sharps in both staves, consistent with opening.
Forward repeat precedes P003 after two full introduction bars. Backward repeat follows P035, first ending starts P034 and ends P035.

Raw-count detector cannot mean physically missing P120-P147: SmartScore raw119 has final D5 over D4/F#4 and B2/F#3/B3, rests and final barline matching P147. Its opening raw1 has E4/G4 melody and held G2 matching P031, with raw4-5 first-ending landmarks matching P034-P035. First print page is absent, not final page.

limitations: Landmark inspection confirms opening omission and defeats raw-count missing-tail inference; it does not complete full SmartScore correspondence or MARKS/ROUTE audit. SmartScore raw6 number=1 ending is reader evidence, not a source reading of the second ending.
